title: Help messages
description: Maps every consumer-facing message id of the copy catalog (conformance/parity/copy.en.json) to the Help page that explains it. The id is the heading anchor and the /docs/help/code/<id>/ redirect path. DOC-03a owns the shape; DOC-05a fills the data.

pages.description: The pages under help/messages/, by file name without extension. `index` is the A to Z index.

group.description: The Help task group the page sits last in (docs plan section 3.2).

messages.description: One entry per message id. A catalog `codes` key is its own id; a `gate` or `activation` key is prefixed with its group and a dot; the fallback is `fallback`.

entry.description: Ids that carry the same on-screen title share one heading; give them the same `entry` and the first id owns the heading.

article.description: A Help article (path under help/) this message links to.

why.description: Why you see this: one or two plain sentences.

fix.description: What to do: one or two plain sentences.

developerOnly.description: Ids listed under Other messages as developer-only: the app's developer needs to fix them.
